name: Happy Monday
business_model: paid job listings from 1799 UAH; employer profile from 6000 UAH per month
notes: Developer page links a job feed and API v4 documentation. API key or access requirements are not stated; other integration requests go by email to the product team. Prices not shown. Ukrainian job platform. A public job feed (JSON and XML) needs no key and is rate limited to 30 requests per minute per IP. The API v4 needs a company key created in the company cabinet. Only Ukrainian language switch was seen. No partner program was stated. Prices shown on the employer services pag

review.note: Services page shows listing prices; developer pages document a public feed and API v4 with self-serve keys; no headquarters or parent stated.
